title: palimpsest: Reproduction harness for burned-in PHI removal on the MIDI-B benchmark
description: Reproduction harness for the manuscript "An On-Premise, Open-Weights Vision-Language Pipeline for Burned-In PHI Removal: Detection, Decision, and Image Degradation on MIDI-B." Implements the published PHI-classifier, spatial-prior fallback and margin-rule specification (Supplementary Material A) and reproduces, from the public MIDI-B benchmark and public Florence-2-base weights, the controlled detector-swap (detection 34/33/11, classifier 10/10), clean removal (33/35) and the degradation-removal profile. Version 1.1.0 adds the revision round: the tuned-OCR configuration grid, the rendering measurement, the dciodvfy conformance run with its matched input control, the nine corruption conditions and a headless driver for the fairly configured RSNA CTP arm with its positive and negative controls, together with machine-readable results for every number added in revision. Contains no proprietary code; the vendor zone catalogue is withheld, and the six revision scripts that call into the withheld de-identification pipeline are shipped as run and labelled as such.
